inspection_note: Shattered window clearly visible; good contrast.

image_note: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth beside the newly installed 'Department of War' plaque at the Pentagon River Entrance, 13 November 2025 (Flickr 54921967441). Follow-on to the 5 September 2025 order, not the signing itself. Replaces the saved 'simplified logo' file (unknown author, described as unofficial).
inspection_note: Plaque text 'DEPARTMENT OF WAR' legible; light stone facade contrasts with dark card.

image_note: Periodic table with a completed seventh row showing Nh (113), Mc (115), Ts (117) and Og (118) with their names. Raster thumbnail of the SVG. Replaces the saved oganesson tile, whose white '118' on light grey was hard to read; the saved tile (CC BY 2.5, Albedo-ukr) remains an alternative.
inspection_note: Opaque white background, colour blocks; symbols legible at card width, small element names readable only when enlarged.

image_note: Colourised scanning electron micrograph of Neisseria gonorrhoeae diplococci, NIAID Rocky Mountain Laboratories (Flickr 53136008302). Illustrates the bacterium, not the vaccine. Replaces the saved 1973 CDC micrograph, whose three-panel disc views did not visibly show the bacterium.
inspection_note: Purple/blue paired cocci, sharp, fills frame; reads well on dark.
